title: 第5章 我叫陆安第6章 星火学院
content_zh:
江水汹涌，将小六的身体飞快卷入水底。他依然昏迷着，任凭自己随着江水往下漂流。
小六感觉不到任何事物，只觉得自己的脑袋浑浑噩噩，脑海里一阵黑一阵白，又或是电闪雷鸣，总有一些支离破碎的片段在自己脑袋里闪过。
“轰隆隆……”
“那你就跟娘亲的姓，叫陆安。”
娘亲？
这个声音好听的女人是谁？
咕咚咚……滚滚江水中，小六只觉得这一幕非常熟悉，似乎在这些混乱的画面中，自己也曾遭遇过一样的情况。
记忆碎片依然在闪过，突然有一幅画面，他见到一阵光芒。
这光芒位于江水之下，最开始只是一个光点，最后越来越大，将他包住。
“如果有来生，你还愿意当我的孩子，我一定会好好照顾你……”
又是这个女人的声音，这女人是谁，我从没听过！
小六努力去想，想看清这个女人的样子，可是画面中一切都太模糊，他什么也看不清。
他只能听到，那是一个风云皆变、暴雨滂沱的夜晚。
跟着，他便彻底失去意识。
当小六醒来的时候，他躺在一个小河流的旁边。阳光刺眼，他撇过头，想用手挡住自己的眼睛，却感觉到浑身一阵剧痛。
“嘶……”小六忍不住吸了口气，跟着忍痛站了起来，缓缓活动自己的筋骨。
身为奴隶，小六虽然没有被哪家买走，但从四岁就已经开始干活。陪码头那些富家小孩玩耍，给人家当马骑，在码头的海水里泡过整整一天就为了扶着一个标杆，也被别人打过无数次皮开肉绽。他从小就不知道什么是苦，只知道如何快速适应环境。他动了动后感觉自己身体舒服多了，忍不住松了一口气。
可跟着，他仿佛想起了什么，脸色一下子变得难看起来。
爹，娘，全都死了……
小六只觉得自己心脏疼，疼得让他站不起来，整个人跪在地上，疼得眼泪簌簌往下掉。

他还记得，自己似乎杀了那些凶手，虽然他忘了自己是怎么做到的，但他记得那些人都死了。
只是，那些人就算是死一万次也不能把自己的爹娘换回来。他很恨，恨为什么爹娘要遭受到这种事情！
就在小六哭着的时候，突然从河边树林中出现几个人。
这些人很年轻，看起来也不过都是十六岁左右的年纪。他们衣着华贵，一看就是富家子弟。而在这些男人中间，围着的是一个漂亮的女人。
这女人很漂亮，一双眼睛很亮，显得古灵精怪很有主见。她的嘴唇涂了红色唇脂，被这些男人围在中心，明显有些高傲得意。
几个人有说有笑往前走，其中一个男生说道，“小灵，明天就正式入学了，未来几年里很可能就不能这么逍遥自在，不如今天我们去酒香楼不醉不归怎么样？”
“对对，今晚不醉不归，玩他个痛快！”其他男生闻言也连忙附和道，很兴奋都觉得这是个好主意。
“切，做梦！”被称为‘小灵’的女生看了周围的男人一眼，说道，“以为我不知道你们这些人打得什么心思？还有以后别叫我小灵，叫我全名听到了没？”
周围男生闻言一脸尴尬，刚刚提议的男生也只好连忙说道，“好好，楚灵是我错了……”
“哼！”女生哼了一声，往前走去。那些男生也连忙跟上，生怕掉了队伍。
很快，他们没走几步就发现前面有一个男孩跪在地上哭哭啼啼。这男孩穿得最劣质的粗麻衣裳，就像是麻袋剪破了套在身上一样，或者还不如。
裤子也是五颜六色，而且颜色都已经褪去大半，不知道洗了多少次。他的头发也是湿漉漉的，很是落魄。
这几位富家子弟走到小六面前，居高临下看着小六，忍不住好奇打量着。尤其是那少女，打量了一会后脸上露出轻蔑的笑容，说道，“虽然年纪小，但哭哭啼啼的哪像个男人？你们可别像他这样，以后一定没出息。”
其他几个男生本来见到面前的男孩脏兮兮的就很反感，听到少女的话后连忙说道，“我们怎么可能像这个人一样哭哭啼啼？一点男子气概都没有，只有废物才会哭！”
“他穿的好破啊，你们说，他会不会是逃跑的奴隶？”其中一个人好奇问道。
原本低头痛哭的小六在听到这句话后，眼睛突然瞪大。
“是啊！”另外一人恍然大悟，说道，“最近逃跑的奴隶可不少，看他的样子不是个奴隶还能是什么？”
“喂！你叫什么名字！”其中一个男生突然对小六说道，并且抬起脚，一脚踩在小六的背上，“你是谁家的奴隶？逃亡的奴隶，任何人都有权力杀啊！”
content_en:
The river was turbulent, and Xiao Liu's body was quickly swept under the water. He was still unconscious, letting himself drift down the river.
Xiao Liu couldn't feel anything. He only felt that his head was hazy. His mind was black and white, or there were lightning and thunder. There were always some fragmented fragments flashing through his head.
"Rumble..."
"Then you will take your mother's surname and call it Lu An."
Mother?
Who is this woman with a nice voice?
Gudong dong... The rolling river water made Xiao Liu feel that this scene was very familiar. It seemed that he had also encountered the same situation in these chaotic scenes.
Fragments of memory were still flashing by, and suddenly there was a picture, and he saw a burst of light.
This light was located under the river. It was just a point of light at first, and finally grew bigger and bigger, covering him.
"If there is an afterlife and you are still willing to be my child, I will definitely take good care of you..."
It's this woman's voice again. Who is this woman? I've never heard it before!
Xiao Liu tried hard to think clearly, trying to see what this woman looked like, but everything in the picture was too blurry and he couldn't see anything clearly.
All he could hear was that it was a stormy night with heavy rain.
Then, he completely lost consciousness.
When Xiao Liu woke up, he was lying next to a small river. The sun was dazzling. He turned his head and tried to cover his eyes with his hands, but he felt a sharp pain all over his body.
"Hiss..." Xiaoliu couldn't help but take a breath, then stood up despite the pain, and slowly moved his muscles.
As a slave, although Xiaoliu was not bought by any family, he had been working since he was four years old. Playing with the rich kids at the pier, riding as a horse for others, spending a whole day in the sea water at the pier just to hold a benchmark, and being beaten to pieces countless times. He has never known what suffering is since he was a child, he only knows how to quickly adapt to the environment. After moving, he felt that his body was much more comfortable, and he couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief.
But then, he seemed to remember something, and his face suddenly became ugly.
Father, mother, all dead...
Xiaoliu felt his heart hurt so much that he couldn't stand up. He knelt on the ground, tears falling from his eyes in pain.
He still remembered that he seemed to have killed those murderers. Although he forgot how he did it, he remembered that those people were dead.
However, those people cannot get their parents back even if they die ten thousand times. He hated it, hated why his parents had to suffer such a thing!
While Xiao Liu was crying, several people suddenly appeared from the woods by the river.
These people were very young and looked to be around sixteen years old. They were dressed luxuriously and looked like they were from rich families. And among these men, surrounded by a beautiful woman.
This woman is very beautiful, with bright eyes, and she looks quirky and independent. Her lips were painted with red lipstick, and she was surrounded by these men. She was obviously a little proud and proud.
Several people walked forward talking and laughing, and one of the boys said, "Xiao Ling, you will officially enter school tomorrow. You may not be able to be so carefree in the next few years. How about we go to Jiuxiang Pavilion today and stay drunk?"
"That's right, I won't go home until I'm drunk tonight, let's have fun with him!" The other boys quickly agreed after hearing this, and they were very excited and thought it was a good idea.
"Tch, it's a dream!" The girl known as 'Xiao Ling' glanced at the men around her and said, "You think I don't know what you people are thinking about? And don't call me Xiao Ling from now on. Do you hear me when you call me by my full name?"
The boys around him looked embarrassed when they heard this, and the boy who just made the suggestion had no choice but to say quickly, "Okay, Chu Ling, I was wrong..."
"Humph!" The girl snorted and walked forward. The boys also hurriedly followed, for fear of falling out of line.
Soon, they didn't take a few steps before they found a boy kneeling on the ground crying.. The boy was wearing the poorest quality linen clothes, as if he had cut a sack and put it on his body, or worse.
The pants are also colorful, and most of the color has faded. I don’t know how many times they have been washed. His hair was also wet and he was very depressed.
These rich kids walked up to Xiao Liu and looked at him condescendingly. They couldn't help but look at him curiously. Especially the girl, after looking at him for a while, a contemptuous smile appeared on her face, and she said, "Although he is young, how can he cry like a man? Don't be like him, you will definitely have no future."
Several other boys were disgusted when they saw the dirty boy in front of them. After hearing the girl's words, they quickly said, "How can we cry like this person? There is no manliness at all. Only losers can cry!"
"His clothes are so shabby. Do you think he could be an escaped slave?" one of them asked curiously.
Xiaoliu, who was originally crying with his head down, suddenly widened his eyes after hearing these words.
"Yes!" Another person suddenly realized and said, "There have been a lot of escaped slaves recently. What else can he be if he doesn't look like a slave?"
"Hey! What's your name!" One of the boys suddenly said to Xiao Liu, and raised his foot and stepped on Xiao Liu's back, "Whose slave are you? Anyone has the right to kill a runaway slave!"
